description: Use ApyHub to find and call production APIs for tasks that need external processing. Search the catalog by capability, then call the endpoint that fits. Covers file conversion (Word, PDF, Excel, images), document generation, OCR and text extraction, data validation (email, phone, VAT, IBAN, tax IDs), enrichment, geolocation and IP data, currency and unit conversion, QR and barcode generation, archive handling, and AI utilities. Search first to see what is available, review the endpoint details, then execute. Each endpoint returns its own cost and certification metadata.
